usage: CreateTensorFullAlignmentFromCffiWithDwell.py [-h]
                                                     [--platform PLATFORM]
                                                     --bam_fn BAM_FN --ref_fn
                                                     REF_FN
                                                     [--tensor_can_fn TENSOR_CAN_FN]
                                                     [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                                                     [--ctgStart CTGSTART]
                                                     [--ctgEnd CTGEND]
                                                     [--bed_fn BED_FN]
                                                     [--extend_bed EXTEND_BED]
                                                     [--full_aln_regions FULL_ALN_REGIONS]
                                                     [--phased_vcf_fn PHASED_VCF_FN]
                                                     [--minMQ MINMQ]
                                                     [--minBQ MINBQ]
                                                     [--no_phasing_for_fa]
                                                     [--enable_long_indel]
                                                     [--enable_dwell_time]

Generate variant candidate tensors using phased full-alignment with dwell time
support

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --bam_fn BAM_FN       Sorted BAM file input, required
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input, required
  --tensor_can_fn TENSOR_CAN_FN
                        Tensor output, stdout by default, default: PIPE
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed
  --bed_fn BED_FN       Call variant only in the provided regions
  --extend_bed EXTEND_BED
                        Extend the regions in the --bed_fn
  --full_aln_regions FULL_ALN_REGIONS
                        Provide the regions to be included in full-alignment
                        based calling
  --phased_vcf_fn PHASED_VCF_FN
                        Phased VCF file for haplotagging
  --minMQ MINMQ         Minimum mapping quality, default: 5
  --minBQ MINBQ         Minimum base quality, default: 0
  --no_phasing_for_fa   Disable phasing for full alignment
  --enable_long_indel   Enable long indel calling
  --enable_dwell_time   Enable dwell time extraction from mv tag (adds channel
                        8)
